<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Vacation request submitted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive vacation request"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewRequest" name="Approve or reject request"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" name="Return rejected request to employee"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" name="Review rejection reasons"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Request rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateHRNotification" name="Generate notification to Human Resources"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteHRProcedures" name="Complete management procedures"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted" name="Management procedures completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Register" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Receive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Review" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Task_GenerateHRNotification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">requestApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_ReviewReasons" sourceRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewReasons_EndRejected" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_CompleteProcedures" sourceRef="Task_GenerateHRNotification" targetRef="Task_CompleteHRProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteProcedures_End" sourceRef="Task_CompleteHRProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
